test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: Eight teachers – S, T, U, V, W, X, Y, and Z were seated around a circular table facing centre. No two persons were seated together according to the English alphabetical order. S was seated second to the left of T and to the immediate right of U. Y was seated second to the right of W. One person was seated between Y and Z when counted from the right of Y. V and Y were immediate neighbours. How many persons were seated between W and X when counted from the left of X?
solution:
1) S was seated second to the left of T and to the immediate right of U. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55f07ce82c44eda0cd61faf2c5ffa65105c3084881200360e4953f5201a1ba76.png] 

2) Y was seated second to the right of W. One person was seated between Y and Z when counted from the right of Y. V and Y were immediate neighbours. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1af194cb953d5594ec3497616e26ae5ca9a59561bf2707ae2c0c0e2b79955e1.png] 

Four persons were seated between W and X when counted from the left of X

Hence, option 3 is the correct answer
